# Sienna Rhodes - Real Estate

Sienna Rhodes is a luxury real estate agent based in California, specializing in high-end condos and private villas. Her brand exudes sophistication, exclusivity, and refined taste, catering to discerning buyers in the premium property market. The overall vibe is elegant, aspirational, and trust-inspiring — positioning Sienna as the go-to expert for California's most coveted properties.

Signature Services



## California's Most Coveted Properties,Guided by Expertise











### A Practice Built on Discernment & Access


Sienna Rhodes brings a rare combination of strategic market intelligence and deeply personal service to California's luxury real estate landscape. With an intimate knowledge of high-end condos and private villas across the state's most prestigious corridors, Sienna functions less as a transactional agent and more as a trusted advisor — one who understands that acquiring or selling a distinguished property is as much an emotional decision as a financial one.


Her residential real estate practice is built on relationships cultivated over years of delivering outcomes that exceed expectations. Through her network within the department of real estate's most exclusive circles, clients gain privileged access to off-market opportunities and discreet transactions that never reach the open market.






01


#### Strategic Market Guidance


Every engagement begins with rigorous analysis. Sienna evaluates micro-market conditions, comparable sales, and emerging demand signals to position each transaction for maximum advantage — whether you are entering the market or preparing to exit. Her counsel is measured, data-informed, and always aligned with your long-term objectives.







02


#### Relationship-Driven Access


Premium real estate services demand more than listings — they demand connections. Sienna's curated network of developers, architects, legal advisors, and private buyers ensures that her clients move through transactions with confidence and discretion. From condos in California's coastal enclaves to secluded villa estates, access is everything.






















Signature Services


## A Complete Standard of Carefor Discerning Buyers


From first inquiry to final signature, Sienna Rhodes delivers a calibrated suite of real estate services built for California's most coveted properties — condos, private villas, and everything in between.











01




### Curated Property Sourcing


Sienna's access extends well beyond public listings. Through an established network of California developers, private sellers, and off-market contacts, she identifies properties that match your precise lifestyle and investment criteria — before they ever reach the open market.



Exclusive access to off-market condos & private villas across California's premier residential real estate corridors.








02




### Negotiation & Deal Strategy


In California's competitive luxury market, the difference between a good deal and an exceptional one is strategy. Sienna brings analytical precision and measured advocacy to every negotiation — securing favorable terms, protecting your interests, and ensuring nothing is left on the table.



Structured deal frameworks aligned with the standards upheld by California's department of real estate.








03




### International Buyer Coordination


Acquiring California property from abroad demands a trusted local advocate who understands cross-border complexity. Sienna guides international clients through every regulatory, financial, and logistical layer — from initial consultation to successful close — with seamless, white-glove coordination.



Multilingual-ready support with full compliance across RPR real estate and international acquisition protocols.






































The Sienna Rhodes Method



## A Considered Journey,From First Conversationto Final Key






Every acquisition of premium residential real estate deserves a process as refined as the property itself. Sienna's four-stage method ensures each client receives white-glove guidance — from initial discovery through to seamless closing support.




- 01 ### Discovery & Vision Alignment We begin with a private consultation to understand your lifestyle aspirations, investment objectives, and preferred California communities. This confidential dialogue forms the foundation of a truly personalised search strategy.

- 02 ### Private Selection & Curated Access Drawing on an exclusive network across California's most coveted addresses, Sienna presents a hand-selected portfolio of high-end condos and private villas — including off-market opportunities unavailable through standard residential real estate channels.

- 03 ### Strategic Offer Planning Informed by deep market intelligence and years of negotiating premium acquisitions, Sienna crafts a compelling, data-backed offer strategy — protecting your interests while positioning you as the preferred buyer in competitive situations.

- 04 ### Seamless Closing Support From escrow coordination to final walkthroughs, every detail is managed with precision and discretion. Sienna remains your dedicated advocate through closing day — and beyond — ensuring a transition as effortless as the property is exceptional.

About Sienna



## California's Trusted Advisor for Prestigious Real Estate


Sienna Rhodes brings over a decade of expertise to California's most coveted residential real estate market. Born and raised along the California coast, she developed an intimate understanding of the state's distinct neighborhoods — from the sun-drenched bluffs of Malibu to the architectural jewels of Pacific Heights. Her practice is built on discretion, precision, and an unwavering commitment to her clients' vision of home.


Specializing exclusively in high-end condos and private villas, Sienna has guided discerning buyers and sellers through some of California's most significant transactions. As a licensed member of the Department of Real Estate, she combines rigorous market intelligence with a deeply personal approach — ensuring every client feels both informed and genuinely cared for throughout the process.





### What I Stand For


- — Absolute discretion and client-first service

- — Deep knowledge of condos in California's premier markets

- — Curated access to off-market and exclusive listings

- — Transparent guidance from first showing to final close

The Sienna Rhodes Difference



## Listening First.Curating Always.




In California's most coveted residential real estate markets, the difference between a transaction and a transformation lies in the quality of counsel you receive. Sienna Rhodes built her practice on a foundational belief: that every client deserves a trusted advisor who listens before they speak, and curates before they present.


Discretion is not a courtesy — it is a professional standard. Whether navigating the acquisition of a private oceanfront villa in Malibu or securing a penthouse condo in San Francisco's most sought-after tower, Sienna approaches each engagement with the same quiet authority and unwavering attention to detail that has defined her reputation across the state.


Her process begins not with listings, but with conversation. She takes time to understand how you live, what you value, and where your ambitions are leading you — then translates those aspirations into sound, strategic property decisions. The result is not simply a home found, but a life elevated.





“

I don’t show properties — I present possibilities that align with how my clients envision their lives.

— Sienna Rhodes, Luxury Realtor, California

Purchasing a private villa in the Santa Barbara hills was the most significant financial decision of my life. She presented three properties, each one a considered response to what I'd described, and the third was the one. There was no pressure, no urgency manufactured to close a deal. Just calm, expert guidance from someone who clearly takes her role as a trusted advisor seriously. Common Questions

## Everything You Need to Know












### What areas of California do you serve?



I specialize in California's most prestigious coastal and urban markets, including Beverly Hills, Malibu, Santa Barbara, Newport Beach, and the San Francisco Bay Area. My residential real estate expertise spans the full spectrum of California's luxury corridor.










### Do you represent buyers as well as sellers?



Absolutely. I offer dedicated buyer representation with full fiduciary care — from curating private property previews and negotiating on your behalf to guiding you through every step of due diligence. Your interests are always my singular priority.










### Can you assist international buyers?



Yes. I regularly work with international clients acquiring condos in California and private villas as primary residences, vacation homes, or investment assets. I coordinate with cross-border legal counsel and financial advisors to ensure a seamless acquisition experience regardless of your home country.










### What types of properties do you specialize in?



My focus is exclusively on high-end condos and private villas — architecturally significant residences that command a premium for their design, location, and lifestyle amenities. I do not handle standard residential transactions, which allows me to offer truly specialist-level knowledge in the luxury tier.










### How do you communicate with your clients?



I tailor communication to each client's preference — whether that's concise email updates, scheduled calls, or real-time messaging. You will always have direct access to me personally. I believe that at this level of real estate services, responsiveness and discretion are non-negotiable.










### Are you affiliated with the Department of Real Estate?



Yes. I am fully licensed by the California Department of Real Estate and operate in complete compliance with all state regulations. You can trust that every transaction is conducted with the highest standards of professional ethics, transparency, and legal integrity.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/25/2026



Sienna Rhodes - Real Estate ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Sienna Rhodes - Real Estate

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 25, 2026



Sienna Rhodes - Real Estate is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools
